title: Hauler (No Man's Sky)
intro: The hauler is a starship type in No Man's Sky (Hello Games): a large cargo ship type with many inventory slots and strong shields. It is flown with the same controls as every ship of the game; the type changes the values and the cockpit, not the buttons.

panels.name: Hauler: type and slots
panels.text: This lists what makes the hauler ship type special.
panels.context: All controls work as in every No Man's Sky ship; only the values and the cockpit look change.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The hauler has a single-seat cockpit for the pilot alone.
controls.context: The pilot flies alone; passengers are not carried.

controls.name: Type trait
controls.text: The hauler is a large cargo ship type with many inventory slots and strong shields.
controls.context: The ship type changes the values and the look of the cockpit, but not the controls.

controls.name: Classes (C, B, A, S)
controls.text: Each hauler comes in one of four classes, C, B, A and S. Higher classes have more slots and better values.
controls.context: A better class gives more slots and stronger values; the pilot can trade or upgrade ships at stations.

controls.name: Technology slots
controls.text: The hauler's technology slots hold the weapons, the shield, the pulse engine and the hyperdrive.
controls.context: Each slot holds one piece of technology; the ship inventory shows them, and the quick menu recharges them.
